content:
mira (Product Designer): quick design huddle: i'm trying a single-line prereq status strip for the private/VPC wizard. it shows three compact chips: Network | Agent | Keys. chips expand to reveal details. looking for UX + copy + accessibility thoughts. https://figma.com/file/zzz

tom (PM): short wins: users see overall health faster. Q: what copy is on each chip when green vs yellow vs red?

mira (Product Designer): thinking short state + count, e.g. 'Network: 3 checks, 0 issues' or 'Network: 3 checks, 1 issue'. want concise and scannable.

lee (Frontend): implementation notes: chips will be <button> elements. will add aria-expanded on the chip when its panel is open and aria-controls pointing at the details region. also add a polite aria-live for status changes.

jord (SRE): for failing checks show a prioritized remediation and one copyable command. sensitive info must be redacted. example command: `nc -vz 10.0.0.5 5432`.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) not rely on color alone — include icon + text; 2) contrast needs to meet AA; 3) copy actions should be announced via aria-live ("Command copied"); 4) ensure focus order: chip -> details -> copy button.
tom (PM): microcopy suggestion: use 'Ready to proceed' for success, 'Action suggested' for warnings, 'Action required' for errors. keeps tone helpful.

mira (Product Designer): agree on tone. prefer 'Action suggested' over 'Warning'. also want a 'Show issues only' toggle that collapses green chips.

lee (Frontend): toggle should be a real checkbox (role=switch) with persisted preference in localStorage. when applied announce via aria-live: 'Filter applied: showing issues only.'

jord (SRE): logs: show a one-line excerpt and a 'Show details' control. full logs only in KB link. include support diagnostic id.
a11y-bot: final reminder: run axe on prototype, and ensure mobile touch targets >=44px and chip labels are readable at small sizes.

mira (Product Designer): great. owners: lee to prototype accessible chip + toggle, jord to draft KB snippets and redact policy, tom to update ticket with copy. i'll update figma and post link when ready. thanks! :raised_hands:
